༄༅/ /grwa pa mngon shes kyi gter byon phyag rdor gtum po dmar po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// grwa pa mngon shes kyi gter byon phyag rdor gtum po dmar po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ gtum po dmar po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len par 'dod na/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// rang sems hūm̐ yig dmar po yongs gyur las// rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dmar// phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga 'phyar// g.yon pas thugs kar rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin// stag lpags dang ni dar gyi sham thabs gsol// rin chen sbrul rgyan mi bskyod cod pan can/ khro bo'i chas rdzogs me phung klong na 'gying*// snying gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' ni// sku mdog nag po de yi thugs ka ru// ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐// de las 'od 'phros gsang bdag mthing ga'i tshogs// nam mkha' gang bar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim// rang nyid sku mdog dmar mthing 'bar ba yi// phrag gong g.yas su bya khyung nag po dang*// g.yon du gshog pa g.yu yi mdog can gnyis// gdug pa'i sbrul bzung zhal du gsol ba la// rang 'dra'i 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor// gnam sa thams cad grags stong sngags sgras khengs// gdug pa tshar bcad dngos grub mchog thob gyur// oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ thun las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gsang bdag gtum po 'grub gyur zhes sogs bsngo smon bya/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ a mṛta sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā lar 'bru gsum zhu ba las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha hi/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// gsang sngags rigs sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsang bdag gtum po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis bstod cing phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag gcig tu gsungs/ 'di ni bzlas lung dang 'brel bar bdag bskyed rkyang pa la brten nas rtsa ba'i bzlas pa bya tshul yin la/ dbang dang 'brel bar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed phyag mtshan gnyis la brten pa dang*/ drag sngags kyi sham 'dogs sogs ni gzhung dang*/ rje btsun tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil sogs la gsal bar bzhugs kyang*/ deng sang rgyun med pas 'dir ma bkod do// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sgrub pa'i thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las gsungs pa tshigs bcad du bsdebs te bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// //
